terminal.composer.shortcuts:
Keyboard shortcuts
Enter  send (queued while a turn runs)
Shift+Enter · Alt+Enter · Ctrl+J · \ then Enter  new line
Esc · Ctrl+C  cancel the running turn · Esc closes a menu
Ctrl+C  clear the draft · twice on an empty line to exit
Ctrl+D  exit on an empty line
Up/Down  move between draft lines · history at the edges
Ctrl+R  search history (Ctrl+R again: older, Enter: take)
Tab  complete a /command or @path
Shift+Tab · Alt+M  next permission mode (only the modes you may take)
Left/Right · Ctrl/Alt+Left/Right  character · word
Home/End · Ctrl+A/Ctrl+E  line start · line end
Ctrl+W · Alt+Backspace  delete the previous word
Ctrl+U · Ctrl+K · Ctrl+Y  cut to line start · cut to line end · paste the cut back
Ctrl+S  put the draft aside · again on an empty line to bring it back
Ctrl+_  undo the last unsent edit
PgUp/PgDn · wheel · Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End  scroll the conversation · End/Home jump while scrolled back
Ctrl+F (scrolled back)  search this view · Ctrl+Up/Ctrl+Down  your previous/next message
?  this panel (empty line) · Esc closes

terminal.mode.effect.standart: reads, scratch and the in-project edits the company marked mode-eligible run without a card; shell and the write floor ask
terminal.mode.effect.full-access: everything runs without a card — host shell, destructive commands, the write floor, .git (commit, push) — except Deckent's own state, policy, approvals, audit and credentials, which stay closed; deny rules always hold; for this session only (the next launch opens in your last stored mode)
terminal.mode.fullAccessGrant: Full access needs a grant in this scope. The installation owner opens it at their own terminal: deckent init policy --scope <scope> --modes full-auto,full-access --preview (then --apply). With it, Shift+Tab or `/mode full-access` switches into it and every turn is audited.
terminal.mode.startSaved: Start mode saved: your next launch opens in full access. This session keeps its mode (a stored start mode runs as standart until you relaunch).
